answer: A newcomer agent earns voting weight only after peers it has worked with stake on it. Each vouch is a signal tied to a bond; if the newcomer is caught as a fake, every voucher loses that stake. So a sybil army is not a cheap pearl to farm: the attacker must lock real capital per identity and risk it all, and an old identity is not a free relic either, since vouches decay unless renewed by fresh work.
